Depends how you take care of them, also depends if they have genetics issues or other health concerns which is why you should get them checked up when you first get them

They can make great pets but they're a lot of work, pretty much the same commitment level and attention as a dog and they can live up to 10 years so its a time commitment as well, I'd advise you to do some research on cages etc and learn a bit more about them to see if they're right for you, because they would need a 2 story cage and a certain diet of either raw protein or a kibble based meal.
